title: L0 Finale: Your Digital Business Card
story: You've completed Level 0! You now know variables, math, random numbers, if/elif/else, loops, strings, and more. This is your graduation project — a digital business card that shows off everything you've learned. Build something that's uniquely you!
why: Combining all L0 concepts into one project proves mastery and gives you a satisfying showcase of your new programming skills.
analogy: Your digital business card is like a showcase room — every piece of furniture (concept) you collected during Level 0 is on display in one place.

try_it: Customize EVERY section to be uniquely yours! Change the name, age, skills list, fortune messages, and add your own sections — maybe your favorite color from a rainbow list or a mini receipt for your dream job.
tips: Start with the heading and work section by section — don't try to write everything at once
Test your program after adding each section to catch bugs early
Make it YOURS — change fortunes, skills, colors, and messages to reflect your personality
common_mistakes: Forgetting a concept — double-check that you've used variables, math, random, if/elif/else, a loop, AND string functions
Copying the example exactly — the goal is to customize it with your own name, age, and creative choices
